newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent rebounds, but volume modest.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent rebounds, but volume modest.

text.p: SIMEX December crude futures firmed on Thursday, supported by a rebound in NYMEX crude prices on the overnight ACCESS system.

December Brent was last traded at $23.70 per barrel, up 13 cents from London's settlement on Wednesday and seven cents off the intraday low hit earlier. January last traded at $23.30, up 13 cents. Market volume was 150 lots.

NYMEX December crude, which ended six cents down in New York at $24.28, was last traded at $24.42 on ACCESS after earlier reaching a high of $24.54, which also surpassed the New York intraday high of $24.35.
The December contract fell as low as $24.00 in New York but found support and rebounded towards the close. The firmer tone was extended on ACCESS.
However, brokers said sentiment over near term direction remained mixed with heating oil stocks growing in the U.S..
The growth in stocks had taken the top off the recent rally but some brokers said current stocks were still much lower than a year earlier which would offer some support.
